name: Elanaria
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Greetings, warrior.  Your skill grows, but there is more to your profession than you may believe.  To further progress, you must soon find a teacher.

The warrior Elanaria dwells in Darnassus, at the Warrior's Terrace.  She can instruct you.
narrative.offerRewardText: I bid you greetings, adventurer.  Your name rings loudly in Darnassus, for you show promise.  But we shall soon see if you possess the strength of will to follow the path of the warrior.

giverName: Moon Priestess Amara / Kyra Windblade / Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze

chain.subtitle: 5 quests at level 10, 2,830 XP in all.

quests.name: Vorlus Vilehoof
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Horn of Vorlus to Elanaria in Darnassus.

quests.name: The Shade of Elura
quests.objectiveText: Bring 8 loads of Elunite Ore and the Medallion of Elura to Elanaria in Darnassus.

quests.name: Smith Mathiel
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Case of Elunite to Smith Mathiel.
